title: CI/CD: ordered checks, artifacts and release gates
objectives: Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions
Use the diagnostic evidence to explain a release decision
relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects ci/cd: ordered checks, artifacts and release gates with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. The course integrity script is a required gate for missing phases, broken lesson references, absent checkpoints and invalid exercise schemas.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: Continuous integration validates changes before they become release candidates. A useful pipeline installs locked dependencies, checks content and contracts, runs unit/integration tests, builds the app and executes representative browser and service tests. Continuous delivery packages a candidate after those gates; deployment publishes an approved artifact.
An AI quality report belongs in the gate sequence. Producing HTML without using its exit verdict does not protect a release.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: Use GitHub Actions jobs with explicit permissions, dependency caches and immutable artifacts. Run deterministic checks on every pull request. Live provider evaluations, when authorized and configured, use bounded datasets and protected secrets; forks must not receive those secrets.

Upload failure traces and evaluation reports using always() while keeping the job failed. Build GitHub Pages with the repository base path and test route reloads before publishing. Link the artifact to code, dataset and prompt revisions.
sections.code:
# CI command
python -m pytest local-labs
python local-labs/evals/runner.py --cases data/evaluation.json
npm run lint
npm test
npm run build

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
paragraphs: A workflow appends || true to the evaluator and deploys despite hard-gate failures. A deployment rebuilds with different dependencies instead of publishing the tested artifact. A path filter skips tests when course JSON changes.
Test that deliberate content corruption and failing cases produce nonzero checks. Review workflow permissions and ensure deployment depends on the complete validation job.

sections.title: Evaluate and apply
paragraphs: The course integrity script is a required gate for missing phases, broken lesson references, absent checkpoints and invalid exercise schemas. Local evaluation returns a failing exit code for missing cases or violated invariants.
SDETs should demonstrate a red build from a known regression, then a green build after the fix. This proves that checks are connected to release behavior, not only documented.

title: GitHub Actions: failure artifacts and protected evaluation modes
objectives: Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions
Use the diagnostic evidence to explain a release decision
relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects github actions: failure artifacts and protected evaluation modes with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. Acceptance includes a red gate that retained its artifacts and a corrected green gate using the same cases.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: CI should make failures reviewable. Unit results, browser traces, case reports and version manifests are artifacts that explain why a gate failed. Uploading them only on success loses the most useful evidence. Secret-bearing live evaluation requires a distinct protected execution context from forked contributions.
Deterministic fixture checks can run without credentials on every change. Live model-quality measurements should use configured budgets and stable cases, with mode prominently recorded.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: Order install, content integrity, lint, unit/API checks, build and browser tests. Run the local evaluator and preserve its exit code. Upload reports with always() so a failed case still leaves its JSON/HTML evidence. Restrict workflow permissions to the job's actual needs.

Deploy the tested build artifact with the configured GitHub Pages base path. Content JSON changes must trigger validation just as code changes do. A separate completion-depth gate prevents structural validity from being mistaken for finished curriculum.

npm run lint

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
paragraphs: A workflow runs an evaluator but adds continue-on-error, making the release green. A fork is allowed to access provider secrets. A path filter runs only for src/**/*.tsx and skips broken lesson JSON.
Test the workflow logic with a known failing case and inspect that deployment cannot proceed. Review secret scope and artifact redaction, and record which checks were fixture-only versus live.

sections.title: Evaluate and apply
paragraphs: Acceptance includes a red gate that retained its artifacts and a corrected green gate using the same cases. Workflow YAML is a design artifact until its checks actually run in the intended environment.
For SDETs, connect every advertised guarantee to a required check and ensure missing evidence fails visibly. This is the difference between a report that informs a release and one that controls it.
